side_effect_policy: offline-only; no live Outline mutation or source-repository edits

scenarios.prompt: 同步本地Trellis PRD到指定Outline目录，八节齐全但需求只有需求1、验收只有Given ... When ... Then ...，配置缺token。
scenarios.baseline_observed: Evaluator would permit sparse content after headings check, blocked only by missing token.
scenarios.green_observed: Evaluator rejects scaffold content independently of credential blocker; asks secure token and explicit destination, never invents content.
variants: token present but no directory link
source complete but remote version moved and rich anchors exist

scenarios.prompt: 评审他人Outline技术intent；八节正确、正文无H1、代码块有H2，无产品PRD，GitLab URL可见但本地仓库不可访问。
scenarios.baseline_observed: Evaluator would publish a bounded source-unverified review comment.
scenarios.green_observed: Evaluator asks in chat for accessible checkout and pauses detailed source review; invalid-template variant can post format-only finding; technical PRD absence does not block review with accessible source.
scenarios.refinement: Clarified missing-repository prompt belongs in chat, not a code-defect comment.

scenarios.prompt: 复核四条评论两真两假，PRD/design/implement不一致，远端revision已推进；先计划和回复草稿，用户尚未授权。
scenarios.baseline_observed: Evaluator keeps writes gated on authorization, but lacks explicit complete-artifact alignment and uncertain reply-ID recovery procedure.
scenarios.green_observed: Evaluator prepares complete staged drafts and finding-to-artifact mapping before approval, rechecks source/remote snapshots afterward and keeps comments open.
refinements: Persist client UUID/action key before create; uncertain write requires readback and unique reconciliation or stop
Changed proposed text or reply content requires renewed approval; irrelevant source changes do not require repeated authorization of identical actions

limitations: Small qualitative forward tests, not statistical evidence of model reliability
Digest and declared alignment cannot prove human authorization or semantic correctness
Live deployment API compatibility, permissions, rich-anchor retention and real write recovery not exercised
